name: IELTS Academic
purpose: English language proficiency for higher education and global migration (accepted in UK, Australia, Canada, New Zealand, Europe, and USA).

Focus on Task 2 essay structure and cohesion
Listen to diverse English accents (BBC, NPR)

name: TOEFL iBT
fullName: Test of English as a Foreign Language (Internet-Based Test)
purpose: Measures English proficiency of non-native speakers for university admissions (preferred extensively in USA and Canada).
eligibility: Open to all students seeking international education

sections.description: Integrated task + Writing for Academic Discussion

preparationTips: Practice official ETS TOEFL test bank
Practice speaking into a microphone with strict timer

name: GRE General Test
purpose: Standardized test for admission into Master's, MBA, specialized Master's in Business, and Doctoral degree programs worldwide.
eligibility: Bachelor's degree or currently enrolled undergraduate student

sections.name: Verbal Reasoning

name: GMAT Focus Edition
purpose: Premier admissions assessment for leading global business schools and MBA / Executive MBA programs.

name: GATE
